headline: Wells Fargo (WFC) Stock May Be 25% Undervalued On Tokenized Deposits Launch
summary: Wells Fargo stock has more than doubled over the past three years, yet several valuation checks still point to room between the current share price and an intrinsic value estimate based on the Excess Returns model. Wells Fargo has returned 112.5% over the past three years, which puts extra focus on whether recent gains are already pricing in its prospects. headline: Wells Fargo’s CEO Says AI Will Erase Tens of Thousands of Jobs. Here’s Why He’s Still Not Worried About Your Wallet
summary: Wells Fargo's Charlie Scharf just admitted AI will eliminate tens of thousands of bank jobs, then turned around and called the American consumer stronger than ever. Whether those two statements can coexist depends on a timing problem Scharf himself admitted no one has solved yet.
